mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of observations when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0%), or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%) triggers aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of observations when INDPRO is above 105, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1700 thousand units signals reduced residential investment and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1700), or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth is negative and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic growth (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized) signals robust corporate earnings and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances (GDPC1 growth > 2.0%), or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.
